Subject: Fwd: Upcoming ramp — capacity conflict with HelixMed; need prioritization

Team — forwarding Hannah's note. Summary: OrionAI expects 12 A100-equivalent reserved slots starting 2027-05-15 for a 6-month commitment (RDW-DEAL-1298). Meanwhile HelixMed (Procurement looped separately) has a committed tranche that overlaps week-of-2027-05-12 and is asking for pre-warm and predictable latency SLAs tied to their clinical workload.

Options I'm proposing (high-level):
1) Honor both commitments by splitting into 8 slots to OrionAI + 8 slots to HelixMed (temporary bin-packing) and offer priority cold-warm caching to OrionAI for first 2 weeks.
2) Keep the full 12 slots to OrionAI (they're a higher ARR/prod-risk deal) and propose delayed start window to HelixMed with credits.
3) Offer HelixMed a guaranteed baseline with burst to shared pool, and move OrionAI to dedicated but staged activation (canary first week).

Can we get a quick steer on acceptable tradeoffs — cost delta, SLA risk, and whether we can do a canary + KV preload for OrionAI on 2027-05-15? Ben — can you sanity-check capacity numbers vs Week17 planning workbook?

Aditya
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-17 14:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Upcoming ramp — capacity conflict with HelixMed; need prioritization

Aditya / Vivek / Ben —

I ran the Week17 workbook against the fleet shard assignments. Short version: we have 28 A100-equivalent slots in US-west dedicated pool for that fortnight; current committed reserves (post-sales) already mark 18 slots; without intervention we only have 10 free. If we try to allocate 12 and 12 (OrionAI + HelixMed) we'll oversubscribe by 14 slots unless we pull capacity from the shared burst pool which will increase preemption risk for non-dedicated customers.

Recommendation: follow Option 3. Practical steps:
- Approve OrionAI for a phased dedicated activation: 6 reserved slots on 2027-05-15 (canary), + additional 6 slots on 2027-05-22 after validation. Pre-warm KV cache for the canary day; measure tail latency and cold-start token loss.
- Offer HelixMed a guaranteed baseline of 8 reserved slots starting 2027-05-15 with documented burst to shared pool up to +6 during non-peak hours. Include a credit for week 1 if they experience any elevated latency due to staging.

I'll attach the highlighted workbook slice. This reduces immediate oversubscription and gives space for a controlled activation. Someone from Platform (Vivek) — can you confirm we can do KV pre-warm for the 6-slot canary and define rollback triggers (error rate > 1.5% or p99 > 450ms)?

Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Final decision: phased activation + remediation commitments (OrionAI / HelixMed)

All —

Thanks for the fast turn. After validating fleet constraints and commercial commitments, Platform will approve the phased activation plan Laura outlined with explicit remediation/warranty terms for HelixMed. Practical commitments below:

1) OrionAI (RDW-DEAL-1298)
- 2027-05-15: activate 6 reserved A100-equivalent slots (canary) in us-west-2 with KV cache pre-warm.
- 2027-05-22: expand to full 12 reserved slots pending canary health signals.
- Rollback triggers: sustained error rate > 1.5% or p99 latency > 450ms for 30m window.

2) HelixMed
- Guarantee: 8 reserved slots starting 2027-05-15 (as partial fulfillment of contract).
- Burst: up to +6 slots from shared pool during non-peak (00:00–06:00 PT) with best-effort latency.
- If HelixMed experiences >2 SLA incidents in first 14 days attributable to capacity staging, Redwood will provide a pro-rated credit for affected days and prioritize immediate migration to additional dedicated capacity within 72 hours.

3) Mitigations & monitoring
- Platform (Ben) will run a KV pre-warm test for OrionAI 48 hours before activation and provide a readout to both accounts.
- SLO telemetry dashboards for both accounts will be provisioned with 1-min ingestion and alert hooks to the on-call runbook.

4) Commercial follow-through
- Sales ops (Laura) to document amendment for HelixMed contract reflecting the partial baseline + burst and credit terms. Legal to sign off on remediation language.

I'll coordinate the infra runbook and handoff. Laura / Aditya, please confirm you can communicate these commitments to both customers and get acceptance on the remedial language by 2027-04-21 EOD.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
